results.name: Boot installs only the on-demand function; no scan, geometry, network, storage or DOM mutation
Read-only collection separates prose, auxiliary, manual-host and outside markers and ignores lookalike class names
Exact support class is counted separately and does not match a prefix/suffix
No article root remains an explicit null result, including an author archive containing the support class
Nested root selectors do not duplicate paragraphs and samples are bounded
AdSense loader observation strips client/query values and distinguishes lazy script type
Even and odd paragraph medians describe lengths without including auxiliary copy
The requested panel preserves article collection if manual inspect throws or returns a nonobject
Published comparator CTA and editorial poll components are auxiliary rather than prose
DOM order separates before, between and after without using equal fixture rectangles
Auxiliary paragraphs before and after prose cannot invent editorial boundaries
Auxiliary, manual and outside markers cannot become between even with surrounding prose
Separate editorial wrappers still establish previous and next paragraph identities
A marker inserted dynamically inside an editorial P is inside-p rather than between
Empty and advertising paragraphs are not prose boundaries; textless article remains explicit no-p
Filled, optimized, unfilled and done-only INS stay independent of the same between position
Counts and state totals cover every marker while geometry details stop at the sample limit
Nested Google markers own unique INS statuses without double counting and INS markers can own themselves
The panel reports total markers, structural positions and literal statuses rather than sampled paid ads
Repeated manual captures observe a changed status without refresh, mutation or cached counts
Manual startup distinguishes inert hosts and a present script from an initialized API without triggering recovery
Manual INS outcomes remain separate from templates and automatic marker counters
